BrochureContent.Content:
Property Partners Gill & Glynn are pleased to bring to the market this attractive greenfield development site extending to c.0.42 acres, located in the thriving town of Gort, South County Galway. (Closest Eircode H91 H92K). 

The lands are zoned Residential` under Galway County Council Development Plan 2022-2028. The lands immediately adjoin a small mature residential development known as Ballyhugh and a walkway leading to Gort National School. 

The property is conveniently located within walking distance of Gort town centre, just c. 150 metres off Church St. / Tubber Road along the R460. 
Gort town offers a wide range of local amenities including supermarkets, both national and secondary schools, hotels and other amenities. The property also benefits from convenient access to the M18 motorway, providing connectivity to Galway (37km), Limerick (64km) and surrounding areas. 

Development opportunities of this nature rarely come to market in such a central and convenient location and the property is expected to appeal to builders, developers and investors alike.
Further details, available on request from sole selling agents Property Partners Gill & Glynn. Contact: Claire Glynn at Property Partners Gill & Glynn today by phone, email or WhatsApp on; P: 091 884000 / 087 9655584
